finding.title: Killed-controller regression waits for a researcher job that the sleeping proposer prevents
finding.reason: The fixture selects fixture_behavior=sleep globally. study_fixture sleeps before dispatching role, so plan-0000, the first proposer, sleeps and times out. _research_round rejects a non-completed proposer before creating round-0000. The regression waits for round-0000/process.json and therefore cannot reach its intended controller kill, inherited watchdog lock, receipt recovery and call-count assertions.
finding.required_disposition: Preserve the real killed-controller/watchdog/lock/recovery scenario while targeting an actually launched role. Either target the first in-flight proposer job, or explicitly arrange a successful proposer followed by a sleeping researcher; adjust expected counts to that exact scenario. This is neutral fixture migration, not authority or mathematical gate relaxation.
